chunks: Hafs ibn al-Bakhtari and Hisham ibn al-Hakam narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام that he said:
"It is disliked for the muhrim that his garment pass over his nose from below."
And he said, "Be open to the One for whom you entered ihram."

key_terms.أَحْرَمْتَ: you entered the state of ihram
key_terms.الْمُحْرِمِ: the person in the state of ihram
key_terms.يُكْرَهُ: it is considered disliked, not strictly forbidden

ai.seo_question: Is it disliked for a muhrim to cover the nose with the garment during ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a ruling of karahah for the muhrim covering the nose from below with the garment. It also conveys an ethical spirit of ihram: the pilgrim should remain outwardly open and humble before Allah, for whose sake the state of ihram was entered.
